jobs.title: LPG Analyst
jobs.description:
As an LPG Analyst to support our global oil trading team, providing in-depth market analysis, building and updating supply and demand models, providing value-add market insights, and analyzing high-frequency indicators of market dynamics. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland.

Key Responsibilities

• Collating, analysing and interpreting data to produce commodity market insights

• Conduct comprehensive research and analysis on fuel oil markets, including supply/demand dynamics, pricing trends, arbitrage opportunities, and regulatory developments across major global trading hubs

• Build and maintaining supply and demand models, and develop detailed market reports, presentations, and trade recommendations to inform trading strategies

• Provide trade flow analysis and other ad-hoc analysis to support decision-making by senior traders and management

• Collaborate closely with traders, operations teams, and other analysts to identify trading opportunities, monitor positions, and manage risk exposure

• Build and maintain proprietary models and tools for market analysis, forecasting, and scenario planning.

• Stay up-to-date on industry news, market intelligence, and competitor activities to provide a competitive edge

• Establish strong relationships with key market participants, including refiners, suppliers, and customers, to gather market intelligence.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related quantitative field;

• Minimum of 4 years of experience in commodity analysis or a related analytical role, preferably with exposure to fuel oil/refined products markets

• Prior experience in commodity research, specifically in LPG analytics

• Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex data sets and extract meaningful insights

• Experience using trade data, data visualization tools and statistical data modeling software.

• Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Python, R, SQL) and Microsoft Office suite.

• Knowledge of commodity trading fundamentals, risk management principles, and financial modeling

• Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced educational degree

• Fluency in another foreign language

• Programming experience and a solid understanding of database concepts (Python and SQL preferred; R, MATLAB or VBA beneficial).

• Direct knowledge of LPG markets

Attributes for success

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely

• Strong intrinsic interest in financial markets, geopolitical developments and a sound understanding of economic theory and cycles

• Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Ability to work independently and proactively to deliver timely results.

• Analytical mindset and critical thinking skills, with an emphasis on providing proactive insights that have tradeable value.

Work Authorization:

We welcome applications from candidates across the globe. Relocation support and visa sponsorship details will be discussed during the hiring process.

- Reporting directly to Head of Oil Research Europe & Asia

jobs.title: Risk Quant Analyst
jobs.description:
Main purpose

We are looking for a Quantitative Analyst to join our team. This is an exciting new opportunity to work on XVA and working capital models as well as contributing to a Quant Library in a dynamic and leading commodity house. As part of the job, you'll be developing and maintaining methodologies and quantitative tools, and liaising with stakeholders across the business (Traders, MO, Risk, Finance, Credit, IT). You will have strong interaction with traders and be part of the daily process of assessing the risk associated to every new transaction.

Key responsibilities

• Developing and maintaining methodologies and quantitative tools

• Liaising with stakeholders across the business (Traders, MO, Risk, Credit, IT) Assess the risk (CVA and FVA) associated to every new transaction

Required qualifications

• 3+ years working experience, preferably in an XVA quantitative business in commodity

• Very strong analytical and mathematical skill

• Comfortable with derivatives modelling concepts

• Strong Python and/or C++ programming skills & experience

• Experience in delivering production quality code, including use of source control, continuous integration, unit and regression testing

Preferred qualifications

• Knowledge of working capital / cash at risk models within physical commodity space would be a plus

• Master’s or higher numerate degree in Maths, Engineering, Physics, Science, Finance, or related field

Attributes for success

• Ownership : Takes full responsibility for models, methodologies, and outputs, ensuring accuracy, robustness, and timely delivery in a high-impact environment

• Attention to Detail : Demonstrates precision and rigor when developing, reviewing, and maintaining quantitative models and data

• Communication : Clearly explains complex quantitative concepts to traders and non-technical stakeholders, supporting informed decision-making

• Organizational Skills : Effectively manages multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders while maintaining high standards of documentation and governance

• Resilience : Performs well under pressure in a fast-paced trading environment, adapting quickly to changing priorities and market conditions

• Analytical Thinking : Applies strong problem-solving skills to assess risk, interpret model outputs, and translate analysis into commercial insight

Department overview

The Market Liquidity Risk team plays a critical role in assessing and managing the liquidity, funding, and valuation risks arising from Trafigura’s global trading activities.
The team develops and maintains XVA, working capital, and liquidity models that support day-to-day trading decisions. Working closely with traders, middle office, risk, finance, credit, and IT, the team ensures robust risk assessment for every new transaction.
The team sits at the heart of the trading floor, combining quantitative rigour with commercial awareness. Through its analysis, the team directly supports profitability, capital efficiency, and disciplined risk-taking across the Group.

jobs.title: Senior Gas Originator
jobs.description:
Main purpose

We are looking for a Senior Gas Originator with a proven track record to join the EU physical gas desk and work in close collaboration with the portfolio manager and traders to maximise value creation around Trafigura’s EU gas portfolio and further grow its geographical and functional scope to reach ambitious pnl targets.

Key responsibilities

• Analyse existing and new markets for Trafigura and develop sound origination strategies to identify and capture commercial opportunities through flow generation and “non-standard” complex gas transactions

• Grow Trafigura’s presence across Europe, building and maintaining excellent relationships with counterparties, industry associations, transport and storage operators etc. in new areas

• Full end to end responsibility of originating, negotiating and executing complex structured transactions

• Constant dialog with traders to maximise value to the portfolio, share market intelligence, and adapt to new market opportunities

Required qualifications

• 5 to 10+ years’ experience as Structured Gas Originator with a well-established network amongst utilities, upstream players, trading houses, large industrials ideally including illiquid areas (such as Central/Eastern/South-Eastern, Balkans, Baltics, North Africa etc).

• Ability to structure, negotiate and execute complex commodities structures (vanillas/spread options, gas storages, pipelines, indexed supply contracts etc.) as well as financing transactions.

• Strong team player able to take ownership of the full deal cycle and steer internal stakeholders (Credit, Finance, Contract/Legal, Middle Office, Regulatory etc) in the structuring, assessment, and approval of complex transactions

• Eagerness and structured approach in developing new markets

• Excellent negotiation skills and a strong commercial mindset

• Familiar with master trade agreements, such as EFET and ISDA, knowledge of financial statements, credit analysis, and risk management practices highly desired

• Fluency in English is required; preferably able to speak additional non-Latin European languages

jobs.title: Market Risk Manager – Oil products
jobs.description:
Main purpose

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Market Risk Manager for Oil Products. The ideal candidate will have at least 10 years of relevant experience as a trader or risk manager specializing in the trading of physical oil products at a reputable physical commodities trading house. This role requires an in-depth understanding of physical oil markets, pricing mechanisms, logistics, quality and blending, regulations, market dynamics, contractual terms, and market participants. The successful candidate will be responsible for aggregating Trafigura's exposure, identifying concentrated risks, and reporting these to the Head of Market Risk. Additionally, the role involves collaborating with front office teams, senior management, and contributing to the development of risk management systems.

This role will report to Head of Market Risk Physical Oil Products and will sit with the broader Market Risk team in Geneva to facilitate interaction with global trading desks and IT teams which support the Market Risk Management organization.

Key responsibilities

• Risk Aggregation & Reporting:

• Aggregate and analyze Trafigura’s exposure across physical oil products in a meaningful way.

• Identify and highlight categories of concentrated risk, reporting findings to the Head of Market Risk.

• Set up risk limits and monitor their usage, ensuring alignment with Trafigura’s risk appetite.

• Market Risk Analysis:

• Design and implement risk scenarios including historical analysis, ad hoc scenarios, and stress tests.

• Ensure accuracy in Value at Risk (VaR) calculations and provide detailed P&L breakdowns and explanations.

• Perform continuous monitoring and assessment of market dynamics, pricing mechanisms, and trading strategies.

• Collaboration & Communication:

• Maintain strong interactions with the front office, providing risk insights and ensuring alignment on risk management strategies.

• Liaise with senior management to communicate risk positions, potential exposures, and strategic recommendations.

• Work closely with the IT and systems teams to enhance risk management tools, ensuring they meet the evolving needs of the market.

• Risk Management Systems Development:

• Contribute to the development and refinement of risk management systems, ensuring robust data integration and analytical capabilities.

• Utilize SQL, Python, and AI to navigate and enhance the existing risk management landscape.

• Ensure systems are capable of providing accurate, real-time data for decision-making and reporting purposes.

• Regulatory Compliance & Risk Governance:

• Stay informed on global regulations affecting the oil market, including environmental policies, sanctions, and trade restrictions.

• Ensure compliance with all relevant regulatory requirements and internal policies. Lead all aspects of the establishment and maintenance of strong contractual risk management processes.

Required qualifications

• Minimum of 10 years of experience as a trader or risk manager in physical oil products at a reputable physical commodities trading house.

• Deep knowledge of physical oil markets, including types of oil products, pricing mechanisms, logistics, quality, blending, and market dynamics.

• Strong understanding of contractual terms, credit risk, and the upstream and downstream oil market participants.

• Proven experience in aggregating exposure, managing concentrated risks, and reporting to senior management.

• Proficiency in SQL and Python, and other relevant tools for risk management and system development.

• Good knowledge of financial derivatives is a must-have.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with front office teams and senior management.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to design and implement complex risk scenarios and stress tests.

• Highly motivated with a collaborative mindset and a keen appetite for system enhancement and risk management innovation.

jobs.title: Precious Metals Trade Finance Officer
jobs.description:
Main purpose
Trafigura is seeking an expert Trade Finance Officer to join our team in Geneva. Candidate needs to feel comfortable in a fast-paced environment, utilising experience and skills to handle large trading volumes and high-pressure deadlines.
The TF Officer will be in contact with various internal and external stakeholders, namely our banking partners and commercial traders, and will be responsible for establishing good working relationships with them to obtain optimal, cost effective, and innovative financing solutions for Trafigura on an ongoing basis.

Key responsibilities

• Good understanding of LBMA/COMEX standards, Vaulting process, international bullion markets, and refining/tolling processes

• Handling of Unallocate/allocated accounts, lease agreements/financing, precious repos

• Weekly monitoring and mark to market of any stock positions

• Ensuring timely processing of payments together with running cash positions with the banks

• Risk covering sales where necessary with banks and/or insurance

• Review and Issuance of L/Cs or Bank Guarantees for the group purchases of commodities

• Analysing financing requirements and negotiating with banks in order to place transactions under Borrowing bases, bilateral facilities or Repurchase agreements.

• Monitoring of utilisation and decision making for financing optimization

• Negotiation and Documentation of such financing facilities instruments

• Preparation and dispatch of invoices and original documents for payment under documentary letters of credit received from buyers.

• Finding and structuring the most appropriate and cost-effective banking solutions for physical trading activities

• Controlling and monitoring risks related to the daily purchases and sales of Commodities

• Handling new trades and flows in close coordination with commercial and operations departments

• Acquiring bank lines and/or establishes new banking relationships (entities, products) as and where necessary.

• Participating in the training of junior team members

• Assessing physical transactions for risk and compatibility for relevant financing facility

• Reporting on credit/performance exposure and risk related to finance management

• Handling all aspects of LCs and collections

• Reviewing and approving spot and term contracts and tenders for finance associated risks

Required qualifications

• Minimum 5 years within a Trading Company / Financial institution having gained a good understanding of the principals surrounding Trade Finance instruments and their pitfalls.

• Fluent English

• Experience in Precious metals market with expertise in handling financing requirement related to precious metals

• Capable of handling complicated transactions and getting banks comfortable outside of standard procedures:

• e.g.how to finance it, how to engage with banks, interaction with operations, establish banking facilities

• Understanding of various risk involved in day-to-day operations and good understanding of INCOTERMs

Preferred qualifications

• Additional language knowledge

Attributes for success

• Attention for detail but with capacity to summarize information and understand “global picture”

• Ability to communicate in a clear and concise manner both externally and internally including reporting to finance senior management from time to time.

• Good logical and analytical skills

• The Officer needs to be proactive, establish positive relationships with banks, match each deal with the best bank’s profile, negotiate rates, have cost awareness

• Problem solving and innovator: the Officer challenges the trader’s financing structure proposals by suggesting improvements

• Experience and level of confidence: reactive and stays calm under pressure

• Establishing a good communication network to keep informed about various stages of trade flow during the life cycle of a trade

Working Conditions

• Fast paced: Intraday execution with hard deadlines

• High-pressure: Same-day c

jobs.title: Market Risk Financial Engineer
jobs.description:
Main purpose

We are looking for a highly motivated Market Risk Analyst to join Trafigura’s Market Risk team at the intersection of commodity trading and cutting-edge AI. This role goes beyond traditional risk analysis: you will harness agentic AI to build automated workflows, design analytical tools, and deliver rapid, high-quality insights that directly support trading decisions across our Oil & Petroleum Products, Metals, and Power & Gas divisions. If you are passionate about building things — from polished, production-ready processes to fast, creative ad hoc analyses — and you want to do it in one of the world’s most dynamic commodity trading environments, this is the role for you.

Key responsibilities

• Design and deploy agentic AI workflows to automate data ingestion, analysis pipelines, risk reporting, data analysis, and P&L pipelines — dramatically reducing manual effort and accelerating time-to-insight across the team

• Champion agentic AI adoption across the market risk function — building a shared library of reusable AI agents and engineering frameworks that multiply the team’s output

• Stay at the frontier of agentic AI — LLM orchestration, tool-use, multi-agent architectures — continuously evaluating and introducing new capabilities to our workflows

• Develop, rewrite, and expand code for quantitative risk models and metrics (VaR, Greeks, P&L attribution) across commodity asset classes

• Build and maintain scalable, containerised data pipelines for daily ingestion and analysis of market data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness. Validate data quality and enforce rigorous standards across market data ingestion pipelines; escalate and resolve production issues (data quality, limit breaches, pipeline failures)

• Stay current with developments in agentic AI — LLM orchestration, tool-use, multi-agent architectures — and actively evaluate their application to our workflows and risk processes.

Required qualifications

• Minimum 2–4 years’ experience in market risk, quantitative finance, or a related analytics role within commodity trading or financial services.

• Expert-level Python programming skills; additional proficiency in F# or C++ is a strong advantage.

• Demonstrated, hands-on experience building or deploying agentic AI — LLM APIs, agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain, AutoGen, Claude API, custom tool-use pipelines), or multi-agent orchestration. This is a core requirement, not a nice-to-have.

• Deep understanding of market risk concepts and metrics: VaR, Greeks, stress testing, scenario analysis, and P&L attribution.

• Expertise in CI/CD pipelines, containerised environments (Docker/Kubernetes), and software architecture best practices.

• Proven experience managing production environments in a financial or quantitative setting — including incident escalation, data quality assurance, and pipeline reliability.

• Excellent English communication skills (oral and written, native or equivalent to C2 level), with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

• Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, or a related quantitative field.

• Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks) and visualisation tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI) for building shareable, production-grade risk dashboards.

• Prior exposure to multi-commodity environments spanning oil, metals, and power/gas markets, and familiarity with the associated market data providers and conventions.

Attributes for success

• Intellectually curious and self-driven , with a bias for action — you move quickly from idea to working solution without waiting to be asked.

• AI-first mindset : genuinely excited by agentic AI and actively seeks opportunities to deploy it across the team’s workflows — not just as a personal productivity tool but as shared infrastructure that multiplies the team’s output.

• Atte

jobs.title: CTRM Business Architect
jobs.description:
Main purpose
We are seeking a hands-on business architect to lead the front to back functional architecture for our Metals, Minerals & Bulk CTRM system. You will be transforming complex, cross-department business initiatives into architectural roadmaps, ensuring alignment of IT solutions with business objectives in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Key responsibilities

• Transform business objectives into a functional architecture view that aligns IT and business teams

• Lead strategic architectural decisions, including buy vs. build recommendations

• Create actionable roadmaps balancing long-term vision with immediate needs

• Proficient in managing cross functional complexity and facilitating complex trade-off decisions, such as balancing global process standards with local market needs

• Support application teams throughout delivery, managing architectural alignment and accommodating change

• Guide the evolution of Trafigura’s functional landscape and conceptual data models

• Partner with technical leads to ensure our technical architecture supports business goals

• Keep up with industry trends to drive innovation and process improvements

• Lead and develop a team of architects, balancing their personal growth with business goals

• Foster a culture of collaboration and excellence across the IT organisation

Required qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in a business analyst and/or architect role

• 3+ years of experience managing and developing people within a fast-paced, high-performance environment

• Strong domain knowledge in commodity trading covering the end to end physical trade lifecycle

• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, frameworks, and modern practices like modular architecture and API-led integration

• Proven success delivering large-scale applications in global teams

• The ability to translate business goals into actionable technical plans, resolve complex conflicts, and make decisions that balance short-term needs with long-term vision

• Ability to plan and execute work independently with a proactive approach

• Comfortable working in a flat, matrix management structure

• Fluent in English

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with a range of CTRM systems

Attributes for success

• Delivery focus with a can-do attitude

• Clear and engaging communicator

• Ability to take ownership of decisions in a fast-paced environment

• Collaborative and inclusive mindset

Department overview
Trafigura is committed to building and maintaining world class IT applications and infrastructure. The Trading IT group directly supports the Trafigura trading business, and this business has started a far-reaching programme to enhance and improve its trading applications using an innovative architecture to support business growth across the full range of business lines and geographies, and to enable the sharing of systems across different businesses.
This programme is aimed at delivering functional capabilities, enhancements and technical infrastructure upgrades to enable continued business growth and enhanced profitability for the firm.

Reporting Structure
Global Head of M&M and Bulk Technology

Key Relationships

• Senior business stakeholders

Trading IT organisation – Product managers, delivery leads, business analysts, functional architects, technical architects, developers, QA and project managers.

Equal opportunity employer
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse workforce! We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or handicap, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Geneva Commercial Graduate Programme
jobs.description:
Designed for individuals with the ambition to become the next generation of traders, this two-year programme offers immersive exposure to global markets and our diverse commodity portfolio. It equips high-potential talent with the skills and experience needed to progress towards junior trading roles.

Our two-year Commercial Graduate Programme begins in September 2027 with a one-month remote summer school course, followed by two six-month structured rotations within our Operations and Deals Desk teams and concluding with a final 12 months as a Trader Assistant on a trading desk specialising in a specific commodity line.

The programme offers broad exposure and practical understanding of the trade lifecycle, from the physical movement of commodities and risk management to pricing and commercial decision making, providing the skills and insight needed to build a successful trading career.

As with all our people, opportunities for outstanding talent are unlimited, and we ensure you are equipped with the knowledge, business development skills and cultural awareness required for a long term, successful career with us.

• Maximum of 2 years post-graduate work experience

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken

• Strong numerical and quantitative aptitude

• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills

• Resilient, dynamic, and adaptable

• Proactive and self-driven

• Excellent communication skills

Applications will close on 16th August 2026.
